g.text: Study A | Fresh-run budget endpoints: availability, quality and elapsed time
Same four large mixed events; one worker; no canonicalization. Middle = (later - earlier) penalty / registrations, both-valid only; negative means lower
penalty. Bottom row includes all executions; x marks no validated map. Endpoints are not a continuous solve trajectory or a time-to-first-solution trace.
